nom: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Anhydrous Solution, Gentle Exfoliating Serum for Blemishes

avis.texte: This peoducts sounds really great and all the ingredients sounds as though it would work for my skin, But the truth is that i got such horrible breakouts of red bumps not acne but flareups After 3 days i noticed it and I used it for 7 days hoping my skins would look glowy like the photos in the reviews Not the case. Ihad to stop and let my skin re balance and now after two weeks of break outs it finaly starting to calm down But for me its a NO And i would say use it on hald of yoir face and see what happens.
Bought this for my step son's who have hormonal and genetics acne and blackheads. After the 2 week adjustment period their faces are clearing up nicely. The have more confidence because of it!

avis.titre: not seeing much of a difference
avis.texte: I'm not going to lie, the oily texture really surprised me when I opened it, but that's on me for not reading the description lol. I've been using it for about two weeks and I don't see much of a difference in my pores, but maybe I just have to wait a bit more! Does give me a nice glow tho

this product was the only one on the shelf when I needed salysilic acid. I used it for about a week before the inconveniences of the oily residue and smell also started to create new acne. I have not had new acne to this degree since before I started using salysilic acid, I would not recommend this version of the acid.
I really love this product. My skin noticeably cleared up after I started using it, and has had fewer breakouts. I'm on my third bottle of it!

avis.titre: Good for sensitive acne prone skin
avis.texte: Compared to the original salicylic acid solution, I found that this one was significantly less drying. While I still got the occasional blemish or breakout while using it, I felt as though this helped keep things contained to a lesser degree. Rarely would I use a full droppers worth, as the oily texture took longer to absorb and settled into the skin after some time, but it still felt better than the original. Overall, if you enjoy salicylic acid but dont like how it dries your skin out, this would be a worthwhile investment or switch.

avis.titre: love this- works better with simple routine.
avis.texte: I've been using the Salicylic Acid 2% Anhydrous Solution consistently in my routine, and I genuinely love how well it fits without overwhelming my skin. What I appreciate most is how gentle yet effective it is at keeping blemishes and congestion under control while still feeling lightweight and non-irritating. The anhydrous formula makes a noticeable difference for me — it doesn't dry my skin out the way other salicylic acid products have in the past, and it layers beautifully with the rest of my routine. I've noticed smoother texture, fewer clogged pores, and a more balanced overall look since incorporating it. This is especially great for anyone who follows (or wants to follow) a minimal skincare routine, which in my experience always works best. You don't need a long list of products when you have something targeted and reliable like this — it does the job without causing unnecessary irritation. I would definitely recommend this to people dealing with blemishes, blackheads, or uneven texture who want effective results without complicating their routine.
Cleared my ance in a few weeks and left me with brighter skin.

I wanted to like this, but the texture is just so unpleasant. With my sensitive, acne-prone skin, it constantly feels so greasy, it never absorbs. I'll go back to CosRx BHA or Stridex Sensitive instead.
This cleared all bumps I had on my forehead, I apply it at nighttime and wake up to the most supple soft hydrated skin!

Items were returned.

i apply this oil every night after washing my face and my fungal acne and blackheads have gone away and my skin feels super smooth! Definitely recommend.
I had recently been breaking out super bad, and just over the course of five days it really cleared my skin up! Definitely recommend

I wasnt sure what to expect using salicylic acid by itself for the first time, but i am glas i gave it a chance. It's almost like a liquid pimple patch! My pimples drastically decreased overnight and took around 2-3 nights of uses to completely disappear.

Some of the reviews claim that this serum causes breakouts. The purpose of this serum is to decongest so it purges any access sebum from below the skin barrier causing it to appear as acne. After the purging process is finished, this serum continues to fight off acne overnight! Using this product with another hydrating serum has saved my skin tremendously! I've been using it every other day for months & I don't notice any weird smell. Highlighy recommned!
This product really helped my skin, it's not too pricey either. Will definitely buy more in the future. It really works well.

Salicylic acid has always had fallbacks for me and the biggest being dryness/flaking. This does the opposite! I dilute it with another facial oil and apply it all over my face and it works SO well. Diminishs and prevents blemishes while giving me a glow!

Made my face breakout . I havr combination skin and i never have acne. I get one little period bump once a month in the same place. Once o started using this product i started getting acne in the places i applied the serum. I stopped using it. Its also pretty geavy

this made my skin so much worse I was trying so hard to like it. I just want clear skin and it created a even bigger issue.

I picked up this product because I know salysilic acid is good for acne pimples texture ect I was scared because of the reviews but this product worked really good for me and made my acne and pimples reduce over the first week of use i didn't really smell anything from the serum like people said and if you want something that won't purge your skin but will work id get this

I can get past the smell but my face broke out the first time I used it, then tried it again to make sure it was that particular product breaking me out. I had really high hopes for this product and thus I am really disappointed. I am 16 and Ive never really struggled with acne in particular. Ive been getting lots of bumpy texture and closed comedones on my face, also experiencing some singular pimples here and there, these happened probably due to me adding into my routine a moisturizer that was too heavy for my skin. These pimples however werent really inflamed or hurt. I decided to try The Ordinary's serum because I saw someone say it saved their skin. So since my skin has been experiencing some problems I hoped this serum would solve them. Ive Heard about "the purging phase" and that this product will most probably cause it. I started using it about 3 weeks ago, and I did, in fact get lots of new pimples. They were inflamed, they hurt and they wouldnt go away. I also experienced some under-skin ones, i don't know what theyre called, but just they don't have anything "poppable" they just hurt and are swollen. And to this day i kept telling myself its the purging phase and i have to just suck it up and keep going. But my skin has gotten so bad ive become insecure about it like ive never been before. I don't think that what i experienced is what the purging phase should look like. Today i decided to stop using this product because it just breaks me out. So sadly i cant recommend this product :(( i added a star because it did a great job at keeping my dry skin moisturized

I have been using this for 3 days. I apply it at night. It does help clear up bkemishes. I'm 49 and still get them occasionally. It dried it up quickly. I purchased to help clear congested pores. I tried 2 drops, one for my forehead and one on jawline etc 2-3x a week and after 3 months I'm having noticeable improvement. I don't have big and painful pimples like I used to. And when I have a pimple, it disappear in 3 days, and it is waaaay smaller than what I had before. I use this product on the morning, and the classi serum in the evening. It even helped me when I had a little bit of eczema under one of my eye. This product; for example, works way better than the niacinamide 10% for me :)

avis.titre: Best product I e used for acne & uneven skin

My forehead that used to be covered in spots under the skin is completely clear and any spots that try to appear go down really quickly. It's honestly incredible and couldn't recommend it enough.

i've been using this for around 2 years now off and on, be aware that you will start purging if you use this but it's pretty worth it. it doesn't get rid of acne completely but it gets rid of it fast, i use this every morning bc i have pretty bad skin, and when i go to wash my face at night most of the pimples will be flattened by then. it's not drying but it is a little oily, i tried the other salysilic by the ordinary and it give me a chemical burn once so i'm sticking with this one.

Just wish it came in a bigger bottle for a larger surface area than just the face.

I see a lot of bad reviews about this product, and the truth is, they likely don't know much how this product should be used. Yes, it will give you a purging stage. It can last 4-6+ weeks before you start improving, thats the truth about active ingredients. Also some people are using this too often, using too much product, or/and not using spf with this. Salicylic Acid is an active ingredient that increases photosensitivty to promote cell turnover to clear skin, photosensitivity increase means it is more reactive with UV rays, increasing the chances of sunburns. So I highly suggest doing this only at night, and wearing spf. Since its an active ingredient and a chemical exfoliant, using this too many times during the week and using too much product can irritate your skin and destroy your skin barrier. I recommend slowly incorporating this into your routine, 1-2 times weekly, then 2-3 times. 2-3 times per week is recommended. Also using other active ingredients/chemicals with this product can give you bad reactions, giving you chemical burns or irritated skin. I struggle with fine texture on my cheeks, forehead, and jaw and struggle with closed tiny bumps and redness. I have psoriatic arthritis and struggle with very dry skin and keratosis. I have used creams with lactic acid but dont like the smell and dont feel like it does much. I used this product ONE time on my legs and feet yesterday. Took a bath today and OMG, it is awesome! Got rid of a lot of my bumps, extra skin on legs and my feet and even some dark patches I had on my knees! With one application… I'm amazed, plus it feels so moisturizing since it is squalene based. 33 y/o female with normal/oily acne prone skin. Especially around my chin and cheeks, I have clogged pores and can get some significant breakouts in those areas. Within 3 weeks of regular use of this, my acne completely cleared up!! I barely have to use foundation and it's such a relief to have my clear skin again. This is an oily consistency and doesn't immediately absorb into the skin - so you need to let it sit on your skin for at least 15 mins before doing anything else. My routine: I use this at night after using TO's Niacinamide and TO's Buffet serums. I press the salicylic acid into my skin, then let it sit for at least 15 minutes before applying a good slathering of moisturizer.

I don't understand why it has such a low rating. I freaking love it and wouldn't trade it for anything else. avis.titre: Hear me out-- You're just using it wrong!!!
avis.texte: Okay, I'll admit, I bought this thinking it would be a sort of regular serum. The oil thing freaked me out at first because I do have extremely oily skin. However, I started to use it more often and noticed that my acne (which was fairly common, especially when I was hormonal), pretty much disappeared. I've been using this along with The Ordinary's niacinamide + zinc serum. I use a toner, usually with AHA/BHAs, then water-based serum, then an oil-based serum. Sometimes (rarely) I use moisturizer. I will also use their AHA/BHA mask a couple times a week. However, it's definitely THIS serum that has basically discontinued my acne. My tips: use 2-3 drops if you are not doing facial massage or gua sha. If you are, use about 4 drops. I do recommend facial massage/gua sha, it helps reduce acne scarring. Rub it into the hands and then PRESS it into the face. After a few minutes, gently dab away some of the excess oil. For use under makeup, you can use a bit of powder before applying foundation or concealer. HOWEVER, after using this for a while, I am needing foundation less and less.
